# Suzuko-chan Official Site

> Official bilingual website for the original character Suzuko-chan and White Wing Hospital.

## Public pages

- Japanese: https://abcderp2.github.io/suzukochan.officialsite/
- English: https://abcderp2.github.io/suzukochan.officialsite/en.html

## Official White Wing Hospital names

- White Wing Hospital
- ホワイトウィング病院
- White Wing病院

All three forms are official. The primary form used on the Japanese site is White Wing病院. Both blue-wing and white-wing symbols are official variants.

## Machine-readable resources

- Sitemap: https://abcderp2.github.io/suzukochan.officialsite/sitemap.xml
- Crawler preferences: https://abcderp2.github.io/suzukochan.officialsite/robots.txt

## Access and use

AI visits are welcome. Search engines and AI services may read, index, summarize, cite, and link to public information for search results and user-requested answers.

Specific uses of the Suzuko-chan character, images, settings, and official White Wing Hospital background visuals remain governed by the guidelines on the official site and the repository LICENSE. This machine-readable access statement does not override those terms. Suzuki retains the rights concerning the Suzuko-chan character, images, settings, White Wing Hospital visuals, and official status.
